body.p: An ermine. Why does the ermine have a black end of a tail. Because it is a thief. It is a thief, it likes stealing games. Once it entered a tent. It thought it would find something to eat. There is always something in a tent. People saw the ermine. One woman ran screaming after an ermine. And he runs, then jumps, then jumps, then runs. It wants to run away from the tent. He was running and dropped a fire stick. On this stick hung a kettle and a cauldron over the fire. This stick was covered in ashes. It smeared the end of ermine's tail with ashes. Since then, the ermine's tail has remained black.
